subject: Recap & next steps — identify budget owner / procurement contacts (SparkFlow)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Recap & next steps — identify budget owner / procurement contacts (SparkFlow)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: reduce inference cost for your QA/triage pipeline while keeping median token latency under 120ms and preserving PII controls.
- Key success criteria you shared: predictable per-token unit cost, regionally isolated logs, and a simple canary rollback path.
- Timeline you mentioned: pilot by late Sept, procurement sign-off in Oct.

As discussed, two quick asks to unblock us on the next step: 
1) Can you confirm who is the economic/budget owner for this project? (name/title/email) — we want to make sure proposals hit the right inbox.
2) Can you share the best procurement contact and any standard PO / vendor paperwork requirements?

Next steps I propose: 
- If you can reply with the budget owner + procurement contact, I will:
  * Introduce our procurement lead (Monica Patel) to your procurement team.
  * Share a short RFI and an SOW draft for internal review.
- If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min procurement + security sync next week to walk through data handling and SLAs.

Attached: short RFI (one-pager) and a preliminary SOW draft for scope/estimate.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SparkFlow-RFI.pdf (application/pdf), Redwood-SOW-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Thanks Camila — great conversation. A few quick answers: 

- Economic/budget owner: Priya Nambiar, VP Finance (priya.nambiar@sparkflow.io). She owns approvals for POCs > $25k.
- Procurement contact: procurement@sparkflow.io (managed by our vendor team; cc'd is fine).

On your on-prem question: we prefer cloud-first but will consider a VPC/private option if data residency or compliance requires it. Priya will want an estimate of run-rate cost and any capital/commitment options.

Would be useful to get Monica on a call with Priya + our procurement lead (I can introduce). Can you also send a short list of the security artifacts you can share (SOC 2 attestation, data retention policy, encryption details)?
